I couldn't find a name or email for Kwame's night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor in anything I can see. The only mention is in a Coastal team note. It says engineering gave Driftmoor's night dispatcher a manual CSV patch after the tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B. It doesn't say who that person is.

Kwame should have the contact, so it's worth asking him directly. I haven't guessed an address.

Driftmoor is outside pemberline.com, so any mail to them, even a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval. If you send me the contact, I can prepare the note and ask Ruth.
